notes.title: TROUPE 1.1 WAS RELEASE!!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Troupe players,

We have many new features in this update, with a 20% discount for those who haven't purchased it yet :) :)

Thanks for the feedback and for reporting the bugs found![/h2]

[h3]WHAT'S NEW?[/h3]

[list]
[*] We released a translation of the game in PT-BR
[*] Rework of some minions, now they have a stronger visual identity with the castle.
[*] Improved tactile feedback from controls.
[*] Artistic improvement in the negative effect of the frames around the castle.
[*] Rework on the clown's attack and run animations
[*] Rework on some platforms that appeared to be part of the set, and parts of the set that looked like platforms.
[/list]

[h3]FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix: Jango's attack collider's size was wrong
[*] Fix: Game sometimes crashed at the beginning of the fight with Benja.
[*] Fix: Game volume was not saved until re-entering the options menu.
[*] Fix: Some English words were wrong.
[*] Fix: The movement pattern of a platform was incorrect.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Troupe players,[/h2]

[h3]In this update we are fixing some small bugs that appeared during the game and thanks to your feedback. We also balanced some aspects of the game. The complete list follows:[/h3]

BUGS:
[list]
[*] Correction in Jango's onslaught;
[*] Fix in Jango collider;
[*] Correction in the map before Benja;
[*] Bear trap did not release the player.
[/list]

BUFFS:
[list]
[*] The player can no longer die after defeating the boss (this mainly occurred in bosses that release projectiles)
[*] Barrier now prevents you from getting caught in the bear trap. 
[/list]
